missing_message_ids.status: Post not found (deleted or never public)

bot_view.getChat: ok (works for any bot on a public channel; does not imply membership)
bot_view.getChatAdministrators: Bad Request: member list is inaccessible
bot_view.interpretation: The bot is not an admin of @StonkFunXyz (member list inaccessible). @StonkFunXyz is a broadcast channel (portal), not the discussion group. The community group sits behind a Safeguard verification button (t.me/safeguard?start=-1004491672783); its chat id differs from the channel id. It was not probed.

extracted.launch_how: Pinned post points to launchpad stonkpad.xyz; coins can be paired with any quote token; Raydium powers liquidity. No further detail in the channel.
anomalies: Pinned post names the launchpad as stonkpad.xyz, while X uses stonkfun.xyz everywhere. The pinned post was edited 2026-08-20. Treat stonkpad.xyz as unverified; not visited.

limitations: Bot API cannot read past history of any chat; bots only receive new updates after joining, and @Approval44_bot has privacy mode on (can_read_all_group_messages=false).
Full history of the private community group behind the Safeguard gate needs a user-account MTProto client (e.g. Telethon) logged in by the owner.
getUpdates was intentionally not called; no messages were sent; the Safeguard-linked group id was not probed.
